doc.title: Earl Watkins interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Francisco, California, August 7, 2002

title: Tape change; the Vegas club's success
summary: Rowe changes tapes and asks about the Vegas club; it was successful and away from the Strip.

story.theme_name: Tape changes, reel headers and session breaks
story.community_name: Tape changes, reel headers and session breaks

blocks.x: That’s great. I’m going to pause for minute. We’re going to change tapes. If you don’t mind talking a little more.
The club in Vegas that you were talking about.

It was successful for a while, very successful. As a matter of fact the different people from — see it was away from the Strip. See I was only there once. And I was there once. In 1955 when Scobey finished his engagement at the Basin Street in New York I guess — did I cover that?
